The Postwar Threat to Gulf Energy Infrastructure
news.summary_en: As Gulf states build new pipelines to reduce Iran’s leverage over the Strait of Hormuz, Tehran is likely to adapt. Pipelines offer greater resilience, but remain vulnerable to Iranian missiles, drones, sabotage, and other attacks on critical energy infrastructure.

news.title: The AI Export Dilemma
news.summary_en: In this week’s column, Bill Reinsch discusses whether the United States should allow exports of AI technologies and strategies the United States could employ to stay ahead in the global technology race.

news.title: U.S. Foreign Economic Policy Needs a Quarterback
news.summary_en: The U.S. government should empower the Millennium Challenge Corporation (MCC) to be a more effective agency to lead on economic growth abroad.

news.title: The Self-Reliance Dividend: The Imperative of Syrian Refugees’ Economic Inclusion
news.summary_en: The current model for refugee management has failed. Will Todman argues that Gulf and Western actors should advance a new approach that prioritizes Syrian refugees’ self-reliance and private sector integration, making them part of the regional connectivity agenda.

news.title: Space Intelligence: The Foundation of Space Superiority
news.summary_en: Space superiority depends on knowing what adversaries can do and recognizing when their behavior changes. Persistent collection and analysis across government, industry, and allies can help anticipate threats before they materialize.

news.title: The Economic Engine of Enduring Space Power
news.summary_en: For enduring space superiority, the United States will need to ensure its space companies are best positioned to capitalize on broader global space markets and dominate spaceborne commerce.

news.title: Trump’s Space Superiority Executive Order: The Stressors That Will Shape Deep Space Development
news.summary_en: What will sustain a lunar economy after astronauts return? Trump’s space executive order sets ambitious deadlines, but a lasting U.S. presence will depend on sustained demand, investment, and clear rules for operating on the Moon.

news.title: What Is Space Superiority?
news.summary_en: What did CENTCOM mean when it declared space superiority over Iran? Joint and Space Force doctrine give different answers, while leaving unresolved who can make that declaration and what evidence is needed to support it.

news.title: How Commercial Industry Can Form the Bedrock of Space Superiority
news.summary_en: Commercial space companies provide infrastructure and information essential to U.S. space superiority. Sustaining that advantage requires investment in technical talent and authority for companies to defend their assets in orbit.

news.title: The Importance and Role of Private Venture Capital in Maintaining U.S. Space Superiority
news.summary_en: U.S. space superiority increasingly relies on private venture capital to finance rapid, milestone-driven capabilities. With domestic R&D shifting to the private sector, venture funding absorbs technical risk and fields unpredictable architectures to outpace adversaries.
